visual_logic.surface_detail: Mottled 'Olive Green' and 'Sandy Tan' skin; unlike the Metriorhynchids, it features visible, flattened osteoderms along its back.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Hero focus on the 'needle-thin' snout filled with numerous small, interlocking teeth.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Observational and patient; large, upward-facing eyes.

environment.water: Shallow, sun-lit lagoon water over 'Creamy White' carbonate mud.
environment.biota: Resting near a cluster of 'Ancestral Seagrass' with small crustaceans nearby.

visual_logic.pose: Stationary near the seabed in an ambush position, the long snout perfectly still while the tail gently undulates.
